title: The ss14l8 cushion is only as large as an unasserted off-chain config (AYieldStrategy.setAsideBufferRecipient)
description: If setAsideBufferRecipient points at a treasury rather than at the staker, the set-aside buffer never arrives on StableStakerV2's own balance; :521 reads R = balanceOf(this) and measures a cushion of ~0. Nothing anywhere reads or asserts the recipient.
impact: None directly. A single off-chain address, set once on a contract in a different repo, silently determines whether the ss14l8 fix delivers its promised cushion or approximately zero. What is at stake is the SIZE of a protocol-funded cushion, not user principal.
recommendation: Add a view on the strategy plus an assertion (or at minimum a documented runbook check) that setAsideBufferRecipient == address(staker).
caveatOn: f7991b64adc3503e1f57825d8f34eb213d233d3d85cc72724eb3c69dd6c99388 (ss14l8) - after the DEDUP-15-01 withdrawal this is the ONLY caveat on that propose-fixed closure.
keptSeparateFrom: DEDUP-15-01 and DEDUP-15-06: different site, different actor, different mechanism, non-overlapping mitigation.
